name: @justybase/electron-shell
description: Development and test Electron shell for the shared JustyBase UI.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @justybase/web-api && npm run build --workspace @justybase/ui-core && npm run build --workspace @justybase/ui-react && npm run build:bundle
scripts.check-types: npm run build --workspace @justybase/web-api && npm run build --workspace @justybase/ui-core && npm run build --workspace @justybase/ui-react && npm run check-types:only
